status: source investigation; Windows durable coordinator not implemented or accepted
verified_seams: RetainedCopyCleanupPlan is handle-free but requires_retained_retry currently relies on volatile group authority after metadata removal.

Observation.reclaim_all reclaims all payloads, then calls finish_metadata per member. finish_metadata combines metadata-intent admission, pending-member freeze, retained-plan reconciliation, metadata removal and Complete acknowledgement.

Selection binds full registry names/root version and peer control bytes/versions. A newly created coordinator inside that registry changes the guarded namespace; ignoring it or dropping the root/version proof would weaken validation.

Metadata Plan contains Header, journal digest, retained name, native parent/central locations and parent security. It already supports a bounded retry in the same process. Its existing authority must be validated, not replaced with client-supplied serialized proof.
Linux RetainedCopyFinalization is the precedent: canonical server-owned manifest after all payloads complete, removed last; absent final manifest cannot be reconstructed from IDs alone.
implementation_candidate: Prepare paired MetadataRemovalIntent for every selected member while retaining every canonical journal; crash before coordinator publication can still rediscover all member IDs. Confirm this re-admission explicitly in native tests.

Use a canonical backend-owned, externally anchored coordinator namespace that does not perturb Selection registry membership/root versions during checkpoint writes. Bind it to the original registry identity, caller/creator/security and complete immutable cohort/native metadata proofs. Reuse AnchoredRoot validation rather than path-only trust.

Split metadata admission from removal so a durable pending-member checkpoint is committed before that member can be unlinked. Persist verified completed-prefix/catalog acknowledgements between members; a restart may reconcile only the one durably pending member, never arbitrary missing IDs.

Revalidate completed-member absence, unchanged peers, case/owner/DACL/object identities and the intended single-member namespace delta on every load and before mutation. Canonical manifests may carry server-created state; the protocol must never accept a client serialized Plan/path as deletion authority.

Retire the coordinator only after all selected metadata is absent and durable. Preserve the existing explicit uncertainty contract for a final unlink/sync failure; never synthesize Done from a missing ID.
required_native_tests: Multi-member partial metadata deletion, terminate helper, fresh process re-open by canonical coordinator ID without source files, finish remaining cleanup.
Crash before coordinator publication with a partial/all metadata-intent prefix; all original control IDs remain discoverable and re-admission is valid.
Crash before/after each pending checkpoint, each local/stage/central unlink, each completed acknowledgement and last coordinator unlink/flush.

Changed coordinator/header/cohort, swapped native IDs, parent/registry replacement, added/changed unselected peer, reparse/case/DACL/owner changes and same-name recreation refuse before unrelated mutation.
Foreign-user and over-the-shoulder UAC caller binding remains a separate necessary gate before helper Copy is enabled.
limits: This record is a source-backed implementation candidate, not a new serialization/protocol contract or proof of native recovery.
Windows administrator Copy remains disabled until the caller-bound registry, durable restart authority and native acceptance are complete.
